department: Environmental Science, School of Geography, Environment and Earth Sciences

deadline.value: The PhD rounds are 1 March, 1 July and 1 November, but the official page gives no year, so no 2027 deadline is recorded.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You do not need a confirmed supervisor before you apply; the school allocates one after acceptance.
supervisor.quote: you don’t need to have a confirmed supervisor before you apply

funding.value: Wellington Doctoral Scholarships are awarded competitively and availability is limited; the application is part of the PhD application.
funding.quote: Scholarships are awarded on a competitive basis and availability is limited.

entry_route.value: Entry needs a BSc (Hons), a Master's, or an equivalent degree; the 180-point MEnvSc with a research project is one route.
entry_route.quote: Students must have a BSc (Hons), Masters, or equivalent degree to be admitted to the PhD programme.

also.quote: Master’s students who complete the 180-point MEnvSc and include the ENSC510 (research project) are able to apply to do a PhD.

notes: The School's PhD is its highest degree. No department fee, GRE or English rule.
